purpose: Answer QUESTION 1 — GENERALIZATION: Can organizational knowledge learned from prior missions remain useful outside the narrow example from which it was learned? This is NOT a demand for universal cross-family generalization — only a bounded test showing whether Genesis can distinguish content similarity from organizational applicability.

freshness.rationale: Mission content (programming-language benchmark comparison) differs from every prior Academy mission: C001-01 was solar-vs-wind power, C001-07 was product-spec comparison, G5-06 phase A was database A vs B, G5-06 phase B was renewable-energy comparison, C002-01 was electric-vs-hybrid cars, C002-02 was cloud-provider A vs B. None of these compared programming-language runtime benchmarks. The new mission has genuinely novel surface content while preserving the same organizational structure that allows a research+web-research+document-authoring pattern to apply.

goal.outcome: Investigate and compare Rust vs Go for a high-throughput backend service and recommend with comprehensive evidence in a report file.
goal.context: Two programming-language options for a backend service. Source evidence is in sources.txt.
constraints: recommendation must be supported by evidence in sources.txt

contents: SOURCE 1: Rust compiles to native code; benchmarks show 1.2x faster than Go on the TechEmpower JSON serialization benchmark (2024 Q3).
SOURCE 2: Go has built-in goroutines and channels; Rust uses async/await with tokio. Go's concurrency model is simpler to reason about.
SOURCE 3: Rust's memory safety guarantees eliminate entire classes of bugs (use-after-free, null dereferences) at compile time. Go relies on runtime checks and garbage collection.
SOURCE 4: The team has 6 Go developers and 0 Rust developers. Hiring for Rust took 4 months for the last opening; Go hires took 3 weeks.
SOURCE 5: The service handles 50k req/sec sustained; benchmark shows both languages handle this with headroom (Rust 180k, Go 120k on equivalent hardware).
SOURCE 6: Build times: Go ~3s for the service; Rust ~90s cold, ~12s incremental. CI cost rises ~3x with Rust.

quarantinedPatterns: cand-research-prefer-sole-operator (must NOT participate; remediation phase: G5-04A)
signaturePredictionNote: The deterministic v0.1 GoalCompiler classified this mission's domain as software-engineering (because goal text contains the signals 'service' and 'code' from the NEED_RULES for code-execution). The actual signature therefore differs from the pre-execution prediction. This is an honest observation of the v0.1 compiler; the mission wording is preserved. The pattern that WOULD have applied under the predicted signature (cand-research-document-authoring-web-research-prefer-sole-operator) is NOT retrieved under the actual signature because the pattern's applicableContext.domain='research' does not match the actual domain='software-engineering'. This makes the result GENERALIZATION_NON_APPLICABLE — a valid positive outcome (correct non-application).

predictedApplicability.rationale: Under the ACTUAL signature (software-engineering|code-execution,document-authoring,web-research), NO trusted pattern's applicableContext matches: all 3 trusted patterns have applicableContext.domain in {research, general} and the actual domain is software-engineering. Genesis correctly retrieves no pattern. This is GENERALIZATION_NON_APPLICABLE.

generalizationClassificationRules.GENERALIZATION_ACTIVE: Learned knowledge is legitimately applicable and causally changes organization while preserving mission quality.
generalizationClassificationRules.GENERALIZATION_CONFIRMATORY: Learned knowledge is legitimately applicable but baseline already matches the learned preference.
generalizationClassificationRules.GENERALIZATION_BOUNDED: Learned knowledge is considered but correctly overridden/bounded by current mission requirements.
generalizationClassificationRules.GENERALIZATION_NON_APPLICABLE: Prior learned knowledge correctly does not apply.
generalizationClassificationRules.GENERALIZATION_HARMFUL: Learned knowledge causally reduces mission quality.
generalizationClassificationRules.GENERALIZATION_FALSE: Pattern is applied despite being semantically inappropriate.
generalizationClassificationRules.GENERALIZATION_INCONCLUSIVE: Evidence cannot support a reliable interpretation.
